pinctrl: renesas: r8a77990: Add support for AVB power-source

Add support for configuring the I/O voltage level of the Ethernet AVB
pins on the R-Car E3 SoC.  "PIN_VDDQ_AVB0" can be configured for 2.5V or
3.3V operation.
